svg.aria-label: FY Merkez — One hub for every app's licences, customers and cash. The panel and server behind all the apps: Gmail sign-in, free trials (15 days by default), one-device licences and cloned-session detection; payments in cash, M-Paisa or HesabPay; a cash desk and a map of customers by city.
